name: Flutter – LOTR Demo
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; git config --global --add safe.directory ${containerWorkspaceFolder}; sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y curl git unzip xz-utils zip libglu1-mesa ca-certificates nodejs npm; FLUTTER_VERSION=3.41.6-stable; if [ ! -x /opt/flutter/bin/flutter ]; then cd /tmp; curl -fsSL -o flutter.tar.xz https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_${FLUTTER_VERSION}.tar.xz; sudo rm -rf /opt/flutter; sudo tar -xJf flutter.tar.xz -C /opt; sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /opt/flutter; fi; if ! grep -q "/opt/flutter/bin" ~/.bashrc; then echo "export PATH=\"/opt/flutter/bin:/opt/flutter/bin/cache/dart-sdk/bin:$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH\"" >> ~/.bashrc; fi; if ! grep -q "\.pub-cache/bin" ~/.bashrc; then echo "export PATH=\"$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH\"" >> ~/.bashrc; fi; export PATH="/opt/flutter/bin:/opt/flutter/bin/cache/dart-sdk/bin:$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH"; flutter config --enable-web; flutter doctor -v || true; curl -sL https://firebase.tools | bash; dart pub global activate flutterfire_cli; flutter pub get || true'
